content: IIS deployments commonly fail due to file locks: the IIS worker process holds locks on files/DLLs while the site is running, so overwriting files in place during deploy causes 'file in use' errors or partial deploys. Standard fixes: drop an app_offline.htm into webroot before copying files (forces IIS to unload the app pool and serve the offline page until the file is removed), or deploy to a fresh folder per release and swap, rather than syncing over a live running site.
